description: Implementation of Health Sector Projects to improve Public Health Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to implement development projects aimed at preventing the shortages of infrastructure facilities identified as lacking in many Government healthcare institutions including hospitals to meet the increasing health services demands of the people and upgrading facilities in compliance with modern healthcare standards through the development of state-of-the-art infrastructure facilities. Accordingly, following an evaluation of 41 project proposals submitted during the years 2025 and 2026, the Department of National Planning has recommended to commence and implement those projects in 2027. The said project proposals have already been incorporated into the Public Investment Programme pertaining to the period of 2027-2031. It has been planned to allocate provisions for the implementation of 39 projects out of those projects through the budget 2027, taking into account the state of readiness of the said projects. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the said 39 new projects, was approved by the Cabinet.
